<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Generated with glade 3.40.0 -->
<interface>
  <requires lib="gtk+" version="3.24"/>

  <object class="GtkWindow" id="acq_window">
    <property name="can-focus">False</property>
    <property name="title" translatable="yes">📥 Acquisition des données</property>
    <property name="default-width">420</property>
    <property name="default-height">520</property>
    <property name="window-position">center</property>
    <property name="resizable">False</property>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkBox">
        <property name="visible">True</property>
        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
        <property name="spacing">10</property>
        <property name="margin-start">14</property>
        <property name="margin-end">14</property>
        <property name="margin-top">14</property>
        <property name="margin-bottom">14</property>

        <!-- Bandeau titre -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="spacing">8</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="acq_title">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">📥 Acquisition</property>
                <property name="xalign">0</property>
                <attributes>
                  <attribute name="scale" value="1.4"/>
                  <attribute name="weight" value="bold"/>
                </attributes>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="acq_status">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">0 données</property>
                <property name="xalign">1</property>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Formulaire de saisie -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkFrame" id="form_frame">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Nouvelle entrée</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkBox">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                <property name="spacing">6</property>
                <property name="margin-top">6</property>
                <property name="margin-bottom">6</property>

                <!-- Nom -->
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="spacing">8</property>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkLabel" id="lbl_name">
                        <property name="visible">True</property>
                        <property name="label" translatable="yes">Nom</property>
                        <property name="xalign">0</property>
                        <property name="width-request">80</property>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                    </child>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkEntry" id="acq_name_entry">
                        <property name="visible">True</property>
                        <property name="height-request">34</property>
                        <property name="placeholder-text" translatable="yes">Ex : Ventes Q1</property>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                    </child>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                </child>

                <!-- Type -->
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="spacing">8</property>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkLabel" id="lbl_type">
                        <property name="visible">True</property>
                        <property name="label" translatable="yes">Type</property>
                        <property name="xalign">0</property>
                        <property name="width-request">80</property>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                    </child>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkComboBoxText" id="acq_type_combo">
                        <property name="visible">True</property>
                        <property name="height-request">34</property>
                        <items>
                          <item translatable="yes">Nombre entier</item>
                          <item translatable="yes">Nombre décimal</item>
                          <item translatable="yes">Texte</item>
                        </items>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                    </child>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                </child>

                <!-- Valeur -->
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="spacing">8</property>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkLabel" id="lbl_value">
                        <property name="visible">True</property>
                        <property name="label" translatable="yes">Valeur</property>
                        <property name="xalign">0</property>
                        <property name="width-request">80</property>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                    </child>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkEntry" id="acq_value_entry">
                        <property name="visible">True</property>
                        <property name="height-request">34</property>
                        <property name="placeholder-text" translatable="yes">Saisir la valeur</property>
                        <signal name="activate" handler="on_acq_value_activate" swapped="no"/>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                    </child>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">2</property></packing>
                </child>

                <!-- Boutons -->
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="spacing">6</property>
                    <property name="homogeneous">True</property>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkButton" id="acq_add_btn">
                        <property name="label" translatable="yes">➕ Ajouter</property>
                        <property name="height-request">36</property>
                        <signal name="clicked" handler="on_acq_add_clicked" swapped="no"/>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                    </child>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkButton" id="acq_clear_btn">
                        <property name="label" translatable="yes">🗑 Effacer la saisie</property>
                        <property name="height-request">36</property>
                        <signal name="clicked" handler="on_acq_clear_clicked" swapped="no"/>
                      </object>
                      <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                    </child>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">3</property></packing>
                </child>

              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Liste des données acquises -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkFrame" id="list_frame">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Données acquises</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="height-request">220</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox" id="acq_list">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                    <property name="spacing">4</property>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">2</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Boutons globaux -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="spacing">6</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkButton" id="acq_clear_all_btn">
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">🧹 Tout effacer</property>
                <property name="height-request">34</property>
                <signal name="clicked" handler="on_acq_clear_all_clicked" swapped="no"/>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkButton" id="acq_send_btn">
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">📤 Envoyer au traitement</property>
                <property name="height-request">34</property>
                <signal name="clicked" handler="on_acq_send_clicked" swapped="no"/>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">3</property></packing>
        </child>

      </object>
    </child>
  </object>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Generated with glade 3.40.0 -->
<interface>
  <requires lib="gtk+" version="3.24"/>

  <object class="GtkWindow" id="trait_window">
    <property name="can-focus">False</property>
    <property name="title" translatable="yes">⚙️ Traitement des données</property>
    <property name="default-width">440</property>
    <property name="default-height">560</property>
    <property name="window-position">center</property>
    <property name="resizable">False</property>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkBox">
        <property name="visible">True</property>
        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
        <property name="spacing">10</property>
        <property name="margin-start">14</property>
        <property name="margin-end">14</property>
        <property name="margin-top">14</property>
        <property name="margin-bottom">14</property>

        <!-- Bandeau titre -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="spacing">8</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="trt_title">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">⚙️ Traitement</property>
                <property name="xalign">0</property>
                <attributes>
                  <attribute name="scale" value="1.4"/>
                  <attribute name="weight" value="bold"/>
                </attributes>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="trt_status">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">Aucune donnée reçue</property>
                <property name="xalign">1</property>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Choix de l'opération -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkFrame" id="op_frame">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Opération à appliquer</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkBox">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                <property name="spacing">6</property>
                <property name="margin-top">6</property>
                <property name="margin-bottom">6</property>

                <child>
                  <object class="GtkRadioButton" id="op_sum">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">Somme (Σ)</property>
                    <property name="active">True</property>
                    <signal name="toggled" handler="on_op_changed" swapped="no"/>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkRadioButton" id="op_avg">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">Moyenne (x̄)</property>
                    <property name="group">op_sum</property>
                    <signal name="toggled" handler="on_op_changed" swapped="no"/>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkRadioButton" id="op_min">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">Minimum (min)</property>
                    <property name="group">op_sum</property>
                    <signal name="toggled" handler="on_op_changed" swapped="no"/>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">2</property></packing>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkRadioButton" id="op_max">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">Maximum (max)</property>
                    <property name="group">op_sum</property>
                    <signal name="toggled" handler="on_op_changed" swapped="no"/>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">3</property></packing>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkRadioButton" id="op_count">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">Nombre d'éléments (count)</property>
                    <property name="group">op_sum</property>
                    <signal name="toggled" handler="on_op_changed" swapped="no"/>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">4</property></packing>
                </child>

              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Actions -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="spacing">6</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkButton" id="trt_exec_btn">
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">▶ Exécuter</property>
                <property name="height-request">38</property>
                <signal name="clicked" handler="on_exec_clicked" swapped="no"/>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkButton" id="trt_refresh_btn">
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">🔄 Rafraîchir</property>
                <property name="height-request">38</property>
                <signal name="clicked" handler="on_refresh_clicked" swapped="no"/>
              </object>
              <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">2</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Données reçues -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkFrame" id="recv_frame">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Données reçues</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="height-request">130</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox" id="trt_data_list">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                    <property name="spacing">3</property>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">True</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">3</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Résultat -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkFrame" id="result_frame">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Résultat</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkBox">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                <property name="spacing">6</property>
                <property name="margin-top">6</property>
                <property name="margin-bottom">6</property>

                <child>
                  <object class="GtkLabel" id="trt_result_label">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">—</property>
                    <property name="xalign">0</property>
                    <attributes>
                      <attribute name="scale" value="1.8"/>
                      <attribute name="weight" value="bold"/>
                    </attributes>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">0</property></packing>
                </child>

                <child>
                  <object class="GtkLabel" id="trt_result_detail">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">En attente d'exécution…</property>
                    <property name="xalign">0</property>
                  </object>
                  <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">1</property></packing>
                </child>

              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">4</property></packing>
        </child>

        <!-- Historique -->
        <child>
          <object class="GtkExpander" id="trt_history_expander">
            <property name="visible">True</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Historique des traitements</property>
            <property name="expanded">False</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                <property name="visible">True</property>
                <property name="height-request">90</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkBox" id="trt_history">
                    <property name="visible">True</property>
                    <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                    <property name="spacing">2</property>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
          <packing><property name="expand">False</property><property name="fill">True</property><property name="position">5</property></packing>
        </child>

      </object>
    </child>
  </object>
</interface>
